content: Ñáucanchi tucui chi rimashcagunamanda mas alita yuyarinaga casnami: Ñáucanchi pagri amutaga charinchimi. Paiga jahuapachaibi tiyarishcami Diospa ali maqui partibi paihuan pariu mandangahua.
Ñáa Yaya Dios causaushca huasiga mana runaguna maquihuan rashcachan astahuanbas pai quiquinllata rashca man. Chibimi Jesus pagri amu asha Yaya Dioshuan ñahuipura ñucanchimanda cuintaun.

Caran pagri amuga runaguna apamushca aichagunata huanchisha chi rahuaita Yaya Diosma ricuchina mara, chasnallata ima cumbirashcagunatas japisha Yaya Diosma ricuchina mashca. Chasna acpimi Jesucristohuas pagri amu tucusha Yaya Diosma imatas ricuchina mara.
Moises mandashcashina Levímanda mirai pagrigunami Diosma cushcata ricuchiccuna tiyashcauna. Jesusca cai pachallaita causaushca ashaga mana pagrillas tucunmachara.

Israel pagriguna mana jahuapacha huasibi tarabaungunachu, astahuan chicuinta rashcallata tarabashcaunami. Ñáaupa urasca Diosta alabana carpa huasita Moises rangaraushcai Yaya Dios paita nishca: Ricui, jahuapachaibi tiyaccunata ñuca canda chi urcui ricuchishcashina tucuita alita rai nishca. Chiraicumi israel pagrigunaga Diospa huasibi paita sirbisha, jahuapachai tiyaccunata urcuibi ricuchishcashinami tarabaunguna.

Jesus randi jahuapachaibi tiyac huasibimi pagriguna amucuinta tarabaun. Paiga Dioshuan ñucanchihuan alichigara. Chasna rasha Moisesmanda mas yapa alita raunmi. Pai mushuc pactachishami nishca shimiga ñaupa mandashca shimigunamandas mas yali ali shimi man.
Chi ñaupa pactachina shimi quishpichinata ushashca acpiga Yaya Dios shuc mushuc pactachina shimita mana rimanmachara.
Chi israel runaguna mana alita racpi Yaya Dios yachasha casna nishca:

content.text: Chasna agllaita paigunaga chi shimita mana
Cunan cai mushuc pactachina shimiga mana chi
Chasna acpi Diosmanda yachana mangui nisha
Chasna acpi paiguna mana ali rashcagunatas

content: Ñáa Yaya Dios cunan chi mushuc pactachina shimimanda rimashcaraicu chi punda shimiga maucayashcashina mana balic tucushca. Chasna acpi mana yapa unaima chingaringami nishca.
